Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. stdcall(HINSTANCE, HINSTANCE, LPSTR, int) from the CRT at 00bfd0dd; both exits are XOR EAX,EAX / RET 10h, so the process exit code is always 0 and none of the four arguments is ever read (no frame access above the return address). Sequence: CoInitializeEx(0, COINIT_APARTMENTTHREADED) then CoInitializeSecurity(NULL,-1,NULL,NULL,RPC_C_AUTHN_LEVEL_NONE,RPC_C_IMP_LEVEL_IMPERSONATE,NULL,0,NULL); on success CoCreateInstance(CLSID_GameExplorer 9a5ea990-3034-4d6f-9128-01f3c61022bc, CLSCTX_ALL, IID_IGameExplorer e7b2fb72-d728-49b3-a5f2-18eb f5f1349e); GetCurrentDirectoryA(0xbfe) plus '\battlestationspacific.exe' is widened by 004c5e60 and passed to IGameExplorer::VerifyAccess (vtable +18h); a FALSE result calls CRT exit(0) at 008f82ee before Release and CoUninitialize. Both COM-init failure branches still reach CoUninitialize. Then BSP_RandomThreads_Initialize, a one byte slot allocation gating BSP_RandomThreads_RegisterCurrent, and CreateMutexA(NULL, TRUE, 'MidwayThreadMutex'). A non-null handle with GetLastError()==ERROR_ALREADY_EXISTS takes the already-running path: BSP_Startup_ResolveLanguage, a localized MessageBoxW (MB_ICONHAND) chosen by 00425850 comparisons, free of the language buffer, return 0 without closing the mutex or shutting the random subsystem down. Otherwise SetThreadAffinityMask(GetCurrentThread(),1), BSP_GameResourceFactory_GetSingleton stored to 00f8d31c, then on one 0x1c byte stack object BSP_Application_Construct, BSP_Application_Initialize(0,'cachedload'), BSP_Platform_RunLoopDispatch, BSP_Application_Shutdown, BSP_Application_Destruct; teardown destroys and frees the singleton manager at 01090aa0 and clears it, CloseHandle, unregister and free the thread slot, BSP_RandomThreads_Shutdown unconditionally. The Ghidra pseudocode aliases the COM out pointer with the language string object and wrongly returns inside the 01090aa0 branch. docs/WINMAIN_STARTUP.md

after.evidence: Executable host integration now keeps one application-owned SingletonLifetimeDomain and GameplayEffectManager publication/context alive after menu teardown through008F8449. The only owner currently admitted is the actual004C1650 GameplayEffectManager; dispatch calls completed scalar_delete_gameplay_effect_manager_008703e0(flags1) with that live context. Native D0DA64[0]=008703E0 reverified. Removed both no-op menu callbacks; validation calls actual source CRT invalid-parameter service. Strict Win32 build,2 existing CTests and8 reference seeds passed. Executed PE SHA256 347b9fe58a1cca32c9bace63fd33da20bccd786042f868e5c0a4fe381e0c884a:180 title/menu frames, exit0, one registered slot drained, effect and manager publications null, then mutex/thread cleanup. This is an existing typed source-host ownership binding, not complete raw BD0400/profile dispatch or original CRT/SEH ABI. Other singleton teardown and full gameplay remain unproven. reports/game_singleton_runtime_ownership.json
